insight: Its free Enhance Speech filter reconstructs noisy, echoey voice into studio-quality audio, processing up to 4 hours a day in the browser.
name: Adobe Podcast
tagline: Web-based AI audio recording, editing, and speech enhancement.
description: Adobe's browser-based suite for recording and cleaning up spoken audio. Its flagship Enhance Speech filter uses AI to remove background noise and echo and rebuild a voice to sound as if recorded in a soundproofed studio, working on audio and video files. A Studio environment (beta) lets you record, edit, and enhance entirely in the browser, with a free tier and an Adobe Podcast Premium plan for higher limits.
